Personal Assistant

Shipped path

Take one useful task off your plate.

Start with a short brief, a non-sensitive preference, or a follow-up you would otherwise keep in your head.

  1. Ask one question.“Help me plan today in three bullets.”
  2. Save one preference.Ask to remember it, then recall it in a new chat.
  3. Correct it when needed.Review Memory and decide what should remain.
  4. Choose integrations later.Settings explains what each connection unlocks and where its key goes.
Optional Mac observation. Capture is off until you enable it. Screen Recording, exclusions, pause, delete, and local-model choices remain separate from chat. Observation provides history; it does not silently grant clicks or typing.

Agent Supervisor

Unified prescan planned

See the project that needs you.

Supervisor lets you manage coding agents from your Mac or phone, organize them by project, see progress and blockers, and act on decisions without patrolling every tab.

  1. Opt in to a read-only prescan.Check supported local Codex, Claude Code, T3, Paseo, or other session sources on this device.
  2. Choose what to manage.Review discovered projects and capabilities; no blanket access is granted.
  3. See one real outcome.Open a project status, blocker, PR/evidence card, or watched update.
  4. Decide what happens next.Observe is read-only; Propose asks before sending; Auto is explicit and bounded.
Current shipped controls. `/fleet` reads supported session stores and shows work, questions, PRs, and verification evidence. Managed sessions, watched conversations, and Supervisor sends are distinct. Discovery alone never sends an agent message or runs an action.

Both paths

Handoff improvements planned

Reply first. Connect more when it helps.

On Mac, ask whether this is your main computer or a remote host. On iPhone, stay phone-only or connect an existing computer. Pairing is optional.

  1. Get a real reply.Complete model verification and send the first message.
  2. Test notifications.Accept or deny permission; either way, keep a visible retry and skip path.
  3. Verify one setup outcome.Confirm a saved memory, reachable host, project status, or notification receipt.
  4. Recover without guessing.Handle no model, denied permissions, failed provider tests, and pairing failures with local help.
Phone-only is first-class. Compatible iPhone builds can use Apple Intelligence or a supported local/hosted model without a Mac. Shared tasks, integrations, coding Supervisor, and host Computer Use require a reachable host and the capabilities it advertises.

No key · offline · limits

Keep the thread intact.

When credits, daily/monthly caps, network, or a provider stop a turn, OpenAGI should preserve the conversation and explain what happened. Offer a manual retry or an opted-in local fallback; never silently resend a possibly completed request or send local-only context to a cloud provider.

Planned: a versioned setup/help skill for supported local models plus a deterministic help path that can explain setup, permissions, pairing, and recovery without cloud credentials.
